title: Creamy Cabbage & Potato Soup
description: A simple creamy soup with tender cabbage and potatoes.
substitutions: Use evaporated milk for extra creaminess.
Mash more potato for a thicker soup.

steps.text: Add cabbage, potatoes, broth, salt, and pepper. Simmer 25 minutes.
Mash some potatoes, stir in milk, and heat gently 2 minutes.

cookSteps.text: Melt 1 tablespoon butter in a large pot and cook 1 diced onion for 3 minutes.
Add 4 cups cabbage, 3 cups potatoes, 4 cups broth, 1/2 teaspoon salt, and 1/4 teaspoon pepper. Simmer 25 minutes until the potatoes are very tender.
Mash some of the potatoes right in the pot. Stir in 1 cup milk and heat gently 2 minutes without boiling.

title: Sheet-Pan Balsamic Vegetables
description: Colorful roasted vegetables with a sweet-tangy balsamic finish.
substitutions: Use whatever sturdy vegetables need using up.
Add chickpeas for a fuller meal.

steps.text: Toss vegetables with oil and salt and spread on a sheet pan.
Roast 20–25 minutes, then drizzle with balsamic vinegar.

cookSteps.text: Toss 2 cups broccoli, 1 chopped bell pepper, 1 chopped zucchini, and 1 cup onion with 2 tablespoons olive oil and 1/2 teaspoon salt. Spread out on a sheet pan.
Roast 20–25 minutes until browned at the edges.
Drizzle with 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar and toss before serving.

title: Ham & Pea Rice Skillet
description: A fast skillet meal that turns cooked rice and a little ham into dinner.
substitutions: Use leftover chicken instead of ham.
Skip the eggs if you want it even simpler.

steps.text: Heat butter or oil in a large skillet.
Cook rice, ham, and peas 6–7 minutes.
Stir in soy sauce; scramble in eggs if using.

cookSteps.text: Heat 1 tablespoon butter or oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add 3 cups cold rice, 1 cup diced ham, and 1 cup frozen peas. Cook 6–7 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in 2 tablespoons soy sauce. If using 2 eggs, push rice aside, scramble the eggs in the empty space, then mix everything together.

title: Small-Batch Lemon Bars
description: A bright little pan of lemon bars with a buttery crumb crust.
equipment: loaf pan or small baking dish
substitutions: Use bottled lemon juice in a pinch.
Orange juice and zest make a softer citrus variation.

steps.text: Heat oven to 350°F and line a loaf pan.
Mix flour, butter, and powdered sugar; press into pan and bake 10 minutes.
Whisk egg, sugar, lemon juice, zest, and flour. Pour over crust and bake 16–18 minutes.

cookSteps.text: Heat oven to 350°F and line a loaf pan or small baking dish.
Mix 1/2 cup flour, 1/4 cup melted butter, and 2 tablespoons powdered sugar. Press into the pan and bake 10 minutes.
Whisk 1 egg, 1/3 cup sugar, 2 tablespoons lemon juice, 1 teaspoon lemon zest if using, and 1 tablespoon flour. Pour over the warm crust.
Bake 16–18 minutes until the center is just set. Cool before slicing.
